prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” roofer for hail damage in Denver — the right choice depends on your needs, neighborhood, roof type and whether you want a company that will work with your insurance. I can help you find a great local contractor, but first here are practical steps and criteria to pick the best roofer for hail damage:

What to look for
- Hail/roofing experience: specific experience with hail claims and replacing shingles/other damaged materials.
- Insurance/registration: company liability insurance and worker’s comp; local business address and long-term presence in the Denver area.
- Certifications: manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, Owens Corning Preferred, CertainTeed, etc.) are a good sign.
- Reputation: high Google/Bing/Yelp ratings, positive BBB record, and recent local references.
- Insurance-claim help: contractors who can explain the claim process and coordinate with your insurer (but avoid contractors who pressure you to exaggerate damage).
- Written warranty: materials and workmanship warranty in writing.
- Detailed written estimate: line-item estimate, scope of work, materials, timeline, permit and disposal handling, payment schedule.
- Fair pricing: compare at least three estimates.

Questions to ask every contractor
- How many hail-damage jobs have you done in Denver in the last 12 months?
- Are you certified by shingle manufacturers? Which ones?
- Can you provide 3 local references from similar projects?
- Do you carry general liability and workers’ comp? Can you show proof?
- Who will handle permits and inspections? Will you coordinate with my insurance adjuster?
- What is the warranty (materials and labor)? Is it transferrable?
- Do you provide a written, itemized estimate and contract? What is your payment schedule?
- Will I receive lien waivers when the job is complete?

Red flags
- Door-to-door contractors after a storm who pressure you to sign immediately.
- Requests for large upfront cash payments.
- Vague or no written estimate/contract.
- Poor or no local references, no permanent address, or no proof of insurance.

Next steps I can do for you
- Find and list top-rated Denver roofers for hail repair near your ZIP code (I can pull local names, ratings, and contact info).
- Provide a sample checklist and comparison worksheet to evaluate 3 estimates.
If you want, tell me your ZIP code and whether the job is residential or commercial and I’ll search for highly rated local roofers and summarize their reviews and certifications.
